examples.chinese: 我很喜歡這家店的巧克力蛋糕。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xǐhuān zhè jiā diàn de qiǎokèlì dàngāo.
examples.english: I like the chocolate cake from this shop.

examples.chinese: 他們有巧克力冰淇淋嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tāmen yǒu qiǎokèlì bīngqílín ma?
examples.english: Do they have chocolate ice cream?

examples.chinese: 這種巧克力冰淇淋又便宜又好吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng qiǎokèlì bīngqílín yòu piányi yòu hǎochī.
examples.english: This kind of chocolate ice cream is both cheap and delicious.

examples.chinese: 我烤了很多巧克力餅乾，用好看的紙包了一些送給鄰居。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ kǎo le hěn duō qiǎokèlì bǐnggān, yòng hǎokàn de zhǐ bāo le yìxiē sòng gěi línjū.
examples.english: I baked a lot of chocolate cookies and packed some in pretty paper to give to my neighbors.

examples.chinese: 那家店正在推銷巧克力口味的小籠包，我們要不要去嘗試一下？
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn zhèngzài tuīxiāo qiǎokèlì kǒuwèi de xiǎolóngbāo, wǒmen yào bù yào qù chángshì yīxià?
examples.english: That shop is promoting chocolate-flavored soup dumplings; shall we go try them?

examples.chinese: 溫小姐在白色情人節那天，送給情人一盒巧克力。
examples.pinyin: Wēn xiǎojiě zài Báisè Qíngrén Jié nà tiān, sòng gěi qíngrén yì hé qiǎokèlì.
examples.english: On White Day, Miss Wen gave her lover a box of chocolates.

examples.chinese: A:我要去三樓找友美？ B:好。對了，這杯咖啡請你給她，好嗎？
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ yào qù sān lóu zhǎo Yǒuměi? B: Hǎo. Duìle, zhè bēi kāfēi qǐng nǐ gěi tā, hǎo ma?
examples.english: A: I'm going to the third floor to look for Yumi? B: Okay. By the way, please give her this cup of coffee, okay?

examples.chinese: 沒關係，我們可以下個週末再來看。對了，妳要買鞋子吧？
examples.pinyin: Méiguānxi, wǒmen kěyǐ xià ge zhōumò zài lái kàn. Duìle, nǐ yào mǎi xiézi ba?
examples.english: It’s okay; we can come again next weekend. By the way, you want to buy shoes, don’t you?

examples.chinese: 我感冒了，想給老師打電話，跟他說我不能去上課。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gǎnmào le, xiǎng gěi lǎoshī dǎ diànhuà, gēn tā shuō wǒ bù néng qù shàngkè.
examples.english: I caught a cold; I want to call the teacher to tell him I can't go to class.

examples.chinese: 我打電話給她，她沒接，可能在睡覺。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dǎ diànhuà gěi tā, tā méi jiē, kěnéng zài shuìjiào.
examples.english: I called her, she didn't answer; she's probably sleeping.

examples.chinese: A:你現在有空嗎？ B:我現在要跟太太出去，晚上再給你打電話。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ xiànzài yǒu kòng ma? B: Wǒ xiànzài yào gēn tàitai chūqù, wǎnshàng zài gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà.
examples.english: A: Are you free now? B: I'm going out with my wife now; I'll call you again in the evening.

examples.chinese: 中文老師每天都給我們作業。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngwén lǎoshī měi tiān dōu gěi wǒmen zuòyè.
examples.english: The Chinese teacher gives us homework every day.

examples.chinese: A:我要去三樓找友美？ B:好。對了，這杯咖啡請你給她，好嗎？
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ yào qù sān lóu zhǎo Yǒuměi? B: Hǎo. Duìle, zhè bēi kāfēi qǐng nǐ gěi tā, hǎo ma?
examples.english: A: I'm going to the third floor to look for Yumi? B: Okay. By the way, please give her this cup of coffee, okay?

examples.chinese: 請給我一杯綠茶。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒ yì bēi lǜchá.
examples.english: Please give me a cup of green tea.

examples.chinese: 請給我一杯綠茶。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒ yì bēi lǜchá.
examples.english: Please give me a cup of green tea.

examples.chinese: 我會給你三天的藥。你要記得多喝一點兒水，要是發燒了，就吃紅色的藥。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ huì gěi nǐ sān tiān de yào. Nǐ yào jìde duō hē yìdiǎnr shuǐ, yàoshi fāshāo le, jiù chī hóngsè de yào.
examples.english: I will give you medicine for 3 days. Remember to drink plenty of water. If you have a fever, then take the red pill.

examples.chinese: 請給我們一杯紅茶、一杯綠茶。請問一共多少錢？
examples.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒmen yì bēi hóngchá, yì bēi lǜchá. Qǐngwèn yígòng duōshǎo qián?
examples.english: We would to have a cup of black tea and a cup of green tea. How much does that cost altogether?

examples.chinese: 我常常用中文給台灣朋友寫信。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chángcháng yòng Zhōngwén gěi Táiwān péngyǒu xiě xìn.
examples.english: I often write letters to Taiwanese friends in Chinese.

examples.chinese: 十分鐘以前我給他打了一個電話。
examples.pinyin: Shí fēnzhōng yǐqián wǒ gěi tā dǎ le yí ge diànhuà.
examples.english: Ten minutes ago, I gave him a phone call.

examples.chinese: 聽說這家工廠的工人都很辛苦，可是老闆給的錢不多。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō zhè jiā gōngchǎng de gōngrén dōu hěn xīnkǔ, kěshì lǎobǎn gěi de qián bù duō.
examples.english: I heard that the workers at this factory all work very hard, but the money the boss gives is not much.

examples.chinese: 他今天給我介紹了一個新朋友。
examples.pinyin: Tā jīntiān gěi wǒ jièshào le yí ge xīn péngyou.
examples.english: Today he introduced a new friend to me.

examples.chinese: 明天是老師的生日，我們要送他一個大蛋糕，給他過生日。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān shì lǎoshī de shēngrì, wǒmen yào sòng tā yī gè dà dàngāo, gěi tā guò shēngrì.
examples.english: Tomorrow is the teacher's birthday, we will give him a big cake to celebrate his birthday.

examples.chinese: 我們今天要學第十五課，老師會給我們介紹十二生肖。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen jīntiān yào xué dì shíwǔ kè, lǎoshī huì gěi wǒmen jièshào shí'èr shēngxiào.
examples.english: Today we are going to study Lesson 15; the teacher will introduce the twelve zodiac signs to us.

examples.chinese: 你先幫我付，我明天再給你錢。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān bāng wǒ fù, wǒ míngtiān zài gěi nǐ qián.
examples.english: You pay for me first; I'll give you the money tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 那個演員非常喜歡演戲，不管導演給他多麼難演的角色，他都願意試試看。
examples.pinyin: Nàge yǎnyuán fēicháng xǐhuan yǎnxì, bùguǎn dǎoyǎn gěi tā duōme nán yǎn de juésè, tā dōu yuànyì shìshi kàn.
examples.english: That actor really loves acting; no matter how difficult a role the director gives him, he is willing to give it a try.

examples.chinese: 小黃要去便利商店領錢， 我請他幫我買杯咖啡。老闆去歐洲旅遊回來，買了荷蘭傳統的點心送給大家，叫我們去助理那裡領。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Huáng yào qù biànlì shāngdiàn lǐng qián, wǒ qǐng tā bāng wǒ mǎi bēi kāfēi. Lǎobǎn qù Ōuzhōu lǚyóu huílái, mǎile Hélán chuántǒng de diǎnxin sòng gěi dàjiā, jiào wǒmen qù zhùlǐ nàlǐ lǐng.
examples.english: Xiao Huang is going to the convenience store to withdraw money; I asked him to buy me a cup of coffee. The boss came back from a trip to Europe and bought traditional Dutch snacks to give to everyone, and told us to pick them up from the assistant.

examples.chinese: 我烤了很多巧克力餅乾，用好看的紙包了一些送給鄰居。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ kǎo le hěn duō qiǎokèlì bǐnggān, yòng hǎokàn de zhǐ bāo le yìxiē sòng gěi línjū.
examples.english: I baked a lot of chocolate cookies and packed some in pretty paper to give to my neighbors.

examples.chinese: 除夕那天我送給父母一萬塊的紅包，祝福他們新年快樂，大吉大利！
examples.pinyin: Chúxī nà tiān wǒ sòng gěi fùmǔ yí wàn kuài de hóngbāo, zhùfú tāmen xīnnián kuàilè, dàjí dàlì!
examples.english: On New Year's Eve, I gave my parents a red envelope with ten thousand dollars, wishing them a happy New Year and great good fortune!

examples.chinese: 那兩家便利商店同樣提供客人休息的座位，但是第二家的空間比第一家大多了。林媽媽總是給她的雙胞胎女兒穿同樣顏色、同樣大小的衣服。
examples.pinyin: Nà liǎng jiā biànlì shāngdiàn tóngyàng tígōng kèrén xiūxi de zuòwèi, dànshì dì èr jiā de kōngjiān bǐ dì yī jiā dà duō le. Lín māma zǒngshì gěi tā de shuāngbāotāi nǚ'ér chuān tóngyàng yánsè, tóngyàng dàxiǎo de yīfu.
examples.english: Those two convenience stores similarly provide seats for customers to rest, but the second store's space is much larger than the first's. Mrs. Lin always dresses her twin daughters in clothes of the same color and the same size.

examples.chinese: 母親節那天，我親自做了一個大蛋糕，送給最親愛的媽媽。
examples.pinyin: Mǔqīnjié nà tiān, wǒ qīnzì zuò le yī gè dà dàngāo, sòng gěi zuì qīn'ài de māma.
examples.english: On Mother's Day, I personally made a big cake and gave it to my dearest mother.

examples.chinese: 付錢的時候，他從皮包裡抽出一張信用卡交給店員。他參加百貨公司的活動，抽到一台價格六萬元的平板電腦， 真是太幸運了！
examples.pinyin: Fù qián de shíhou, tā cóng píbāo lǐ chōu chū yī zhāng xìnyòngkǎ jiāo gěi diànyuán. Tā cānjiā bǎihuò gōngsī de huódòng, chōu dào yī tái jiàgé liù wàn yuán de píngbǎn diànnǎo, zhēn shì tài xìngyùn le!
examples.english: When paying, he took out a credit card from his wallet and handed it to the clerk. He participated in a department store event and drew a tablet computer worth 60,000 yuan; he was really so lucky!

examples.chinese: 週末我帶孩子們去鄉下玩，他們餵小羊吃草，拿饅頭給猴子吃，玩得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ dài háizimen qù xiāngxià wán, tāmen wèi xiǎoyáng chī cǎo, ná mántou gěi hóuzi chī, wán de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: On the weekend, I took the children to the countryside to play; they fed the lambs grass and gave steamed buns to the monkeys to eat, and they had a great time.

examples.chinese: 華人在除夕那天，都會跟親人聚在一起吃年夜飯、給紅包，互相恭喜新年好。
examples.pinyin: Huárén zài chúxī nà tiān, dōu huì gēn qīnrén jù zài yīqǐ chī niányèfàn, gěi hóngbāo, hùxiāng gōngxǐ xīnnián hǎo.
examples.english: On New Year's Eve, Chinese people always gather with their kinsfolk to eat the New Year's Eve dinner, give red envelopes, and wish each other a Happy New Year.

examples.chinese: A:這個玩具雖然可愛，但是不適合送給剛滿月的孩子，我們還是送紅包吧！ B:也好。送紅包也不錯。
examples.pinyin: A: Zhège wánjù suīrán kě'ài, dànshì bù shìhé sòng gěi gāng mǎn yuè de háizi, wǒmen háishì sòng hóngbāo ba! B: Yě hǎo. Sòng hóngbāo yě bùcuò.
examples.english: A: Although this toy is cute, it's not suitable to give to a child who has just turned one month old; we might as well give a red envelope! B: That's fine. Giving a red envelope is also good.

examples.chinese: 軍人用卡車把食物和生活用品送到災區，發給需要的民眾。
examples.pinyin: Jūnrén yòng kǎchē bǎ shíwù hé shēnghuó yòngpǐn sòng dào zāiqū, fā gěi xūyào de mínzhòng.
examples.english: Soldiers used trucks to deliver food and daily necessities to the disaster area and distribute them to the people in need.

examples.chinese: 剛才我正想給英英打電話時，沒想到她就先打來了。
examples.pinyin: Gāngcái wǒ zhèng xiǎng gěi Yīngying dǎ diànhuà shí, méi xiǎngdào tā jiù xiān dǎ lái le.
examples.english: Just now, when I was right about to call Yingying, I didn't expect that she would call first.

examples.chinese: 春天來了，天氣變暖和了，院子裡開了各種顏色的花，給人帶來一種新的希望。
examples.pinyin: Chūntiān lái le, tiānqì biàn nuǎnhuo le, yuànzi lǐ kāi le gè zhǒng yánsè de huā, gěi rén dàilái yī zhǒng xīn de xīwàng.
examples.english: Spring has come, the weather has become warmer, and flowers of various colors have blossomed in the yard, bringing people a new kind of hope.

examples.chinese: 發生大地震後，民眾都發揮愛心，主動提供救災的相關用品給災民。
examples.pinyin: Fāshēng dà dìzhèn hòu, mínzhòng dōu fāhuī àixīn, zhǔdòng tígōng jiùzāi de xiāngguān yòngpǐn gěi zāimín.
examples.english: After the major earthquake, people showed compassion and proactively provided disaster-relief related supplies to the victims.

examples.chinese: 父母要經常陪孩子聊天、玩遊戲，給零用錢不能完全滿足孩子的需要。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ yào jīngcháng péi háizi liáotiān, wán yóuxì, gěi língyòngqián bù néng wánquán mǎnzú háizi de xūyào.
examples.english: Parents should often chat and play games with their children; giving pocket money cannot completely satisfy children's needs.

examples.chinese: 老師認為這個問題很難，只有一個學生回答得很正確，所以給他加了一些分數。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī rènwéi zhège wèntí hěn nán, zhǐyǒu yí ge xuésheng huídá de hěn zhèngquè, suǒyǐ gěi tā jiā le yìxiē fēnshù.
examples.english: The teacher thought this question was very difficult, and only one student answered very correctly, so he gave him some extra points.

examples.chinese: 我們把考卷交給老師後，老師就把正確的答案告訴大家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bǎ kǎojuàn jiāo gěi lǎoshī hòu, lǎoshī jiù bǎ zhèngquè de dá'àn gàosu dàjiā.
examples.english: After we handed the exam papers to the teacher, the teacher then told everyone the correct answers.

examples.chinese: 打仗期間，許多軍人為國家犧牲了寶貴的生命，也給家人留下了痛苦的記憶。
examples.pinyin: Dǎzhàng qījiān, xǔduō jūnrén wèi guójiā xīshēngle bǎoguì de shēngmìng, yě gěi jiārén liúxiàle tòngkǔ de jìyì.
examples.english: During the war, many soldiers sacrificed their precious lives for the country, and also left painful memories for their families.

examples.chinese: 他把所有的錢都給了女朋友，直到女朋友被警察抓了，才知道自己被騙。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ suǒyǒu de qián dōu gěi le nǚpéngyǒu, zhídào nǚpéngyǒu bèi jǐngchá zhuā le, cái zhīdào zìjǐ bèi piàn.
examples.english: He gave all his money to his girlfriend, and only when his girlfriend was caught by the police did he realize he had been cheated.

examples.chinese: 我等一下要開會，不方便接電話，有事就用手機傳訊息給我。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ děng yīxià yào kāihuì, bù fāngbiàn jiē diànhuà, yǒu shì jiù yòng shǒujī chuán xùnxí gěi wǒ.
examples.english: I have a meeting in a little while, so it's not convenient to answer the phone; if there's anything, just send me a message on my cell phone.

examples.chinese: 媽媽生病時，小華給家人做飯、照顧弟弟妹妹，真是個懂事的孩子。
examples.pinyin: Māma shēngbìng shí, Xiǎohuá gěi jiārén zuòfàn, zhàogù dìdì mèimei, zhēn shì ge dǒngshì de háizi.
examples.english: When Mom was sick, Xiaohua cooked for the family and took care of his younger brother and sister; he is truly a sensible child.

examples.chinese: 管先生這段時間忙著布置新房子，希望給老婆一個又舒適又溫暖的家。
examples.pinyin: Guǎn xiānshēng zhè duàn shíjiān mángzhe bùzhì xīn fángzi, xīwàng gěi lǎopó yí ge yòu shūshì yòu wēnnuǎn de jiā.
examples.english: Mr. Guan has been busy decorating his new house during this time, hoping to give his wife a comfortable and warm home.

examples.chinese: 溫小姐在白色情人節那天，送給情人一盒巧克力。
examples.pinyin: Wēn xiǎojiě zài Báisè Qíngrén Jié nà tiān, sòng gěi qíngrén yì hé qiǎokèlì.
examples.english: On White Day, Miss Wen gave her lover a box of chocolates.

examples.chinese: 每年農曆一月初一是華人新年的第一天。我父母每個月初寄錢給我，但我總是在月中就把錢花光了。
examples.pinyin: 1. Měi nián nónglì yī yuè chū yī shì Huárén xīnnián de dì yī tiān. 2. Wǒ fùmǔ měi ge yuè chū jì qián gěi wǒ, dàn wǒ zǒngshì zài yuè zhōng jiù bǎ qián huā guāng le.
examples.english: 1. The first day of the first lunar month each year is the first day of the Chinese New Year. 2. My parents send me money at the beginning of every month, but I always spend it all by the middle of the month.

examples.chinese: 那部電影沒有結局，是導演要留給觀眾想像的空間。
examples.pinyin: Nà bù diànyǐng méiyǒu jiéjú, shì dǎoyǎn yào liú gěi guānzhòng xiǎngxiàng de kōngjiān.
examples.english: That movie has no ending; it is that the director wanted to leave space for the audience's imagination.

examples.chinese: 這家公司出版的小說，陪著不少讀者一塊兒成長，也帶給他們無窮的樂趣。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī chūbǎn de xiǎoshuō, péi zhe bùshǎo dúzhě yíkuàir chéngzhǎng, yě dài gěi tāmen wúqióng de lèqù.
examples.english: The novels published by this company have accompanied many readers as they grew up, and have also brought them endless joy.

examples.chinese: 我男朋友親手做了一張卡片，還買了一個漂亮的背包送給我， 他的心意讓我很感動。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ nánpéngyou qīnshǒu zuò le yì zhāng kǎpiàn, hái mǎi le yí ge piàoliang de bēibāo sòng gěi wǒ, tā de xīnyì ràng wǒ hěn gǎndòng.
examples.english: My boyfriend personally made a card and also bought a beautiful backpack to give me; his kindly feelings moved me very much.

examples.chinese: 這支手錶是我過世的爺爺留給我的，對我來說具有特別的意義。我的老闆具有獨特的領導魅力， 員工都願意跟著他努力工作。
examples.pinyin: 1. Zhè zhī shǒubiǎo shì wǒ guòshì de yéye liú gěi wǒ de, duì wǒ lái shuō jùyǒu tèbié de yìyì. 2. Wǒ de lǎobǎn jùyǒu dútè de lǐngdǎo mèilì, yuángōng dōu yuànyì gēnzhe tā nǔlì gōngzuò.
examples.english: 1. This watch was left to me by my late grandfather; to me, it has special significance. 2. My boss has a unique leadership charisma; the employees are all willing to work hard following him.

examples.chinese: 只有圖畫，沒有文字的故事書 ，能夠留給兒童想像及思考的空間。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu túhuà, méiyǒu wénzì de gùshìshū, nénggòu liú gěi értóng xiǎngxiàng jí sīkǎo de kōngjiān.
examples.english: Storybooks with only pictures and no text can leave children room for imagination and thinking.

examples.chinese: 從六○年代開始，臺灣就提供農業方面的協助給許多國家，這點讓我覺得很驕傲。
examples.pinyin: Cóng liù○ niándài kāishǐ, Táiwān jiù tígōng nóngyè fāngmiàn de xiézhù gěi xǔduō guójiā, zhè diǎn ràng wǒ juéde hěn jiāo'ào.
examples.english: Starting from the 1960s, Taiwan has provided assistance in agriculture to many countries; this point makes me feel very proud.

examples.chinese: A:對不起，我不小心拿了你的書？ B:原來書在你這裡，我剛才在教室裡找了好久。
examples.pinyin: A: Duìbuqǐ, wǒ bù xiǎoxīn ná le nǐ de shū? B: Yuánlái shū zài nǐ zhèlǐ, wǒ gāngcái zài jiàoshì lǐ zhǎo le hǎo jiǔ.
examples.english: A: Sorry, I accidentally took your book? B: It turns out the book is here with you; I was looking in the classroom for a long time just now.

examples.chinese: 原來是十二生肖，真的很有意思。
examples.pinyin: Yuánlái shì shí'èr shēngxiào, zhēnde hěn yǒuyìsi.
examples.english: Oh! You are talking about the Chinese animal zodiac! It’s really interesting.

examples.chinese: 原來越南的生肖跟中國的有點兒不一樣。
examples.pinyin: Yuánlái Yuènán de shēngxiào gēn Zhōngguó de yǒudiǎnr bù yíyàng.
examples.english: It turns out that the Vietnamese zodiac animals are a little bit different from the Chinese ones.

items.wordHook: 原(originally) + 來(come) → what originally came to light: 'it turns out that...'

examples.chinese: 每年春節時，爸爸都會送隔壁鄰居一盒蘋果，祝他們每天都平安、如意。
examples.pinyin: Měi nián chūnjié shí, bàba dōu huì sòng gébì línjū yī hé píngguǒ, zhù tāmen měi tiān dōu píng'ān, rúyì.
examples.english: Every year during Spring Festival, Dad gives the neighbor next door a box of apples, wishing them peace and that everything goes as they wish every day.

examples.chinese: 我去參加朋友的婚禮，除了送紅包，還祝福他們事事如意、早生貴子、永遠幸福。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù cānjiā péngyou de hūnlǐ, chúle sòng hóngbāo, hái zhùfú tāmen shìshì rúyì, zǎo shēng guìzǐ, yǒngyuǎn xìngfú.
examples.english: I went to attend a friend's wedding; besides giving a red envelope, I also wished them that everything goes as they wish, that they soon have a child, and that they be happy forever.

examples.chinese: 朋友的孩子滿月了，我想送他一份禮，祝福他平平安安地長大。
examples.pinyin: Péngyou de háizi mǎnyuè le, wǒ xiǎng sòng tā yí fèn lǐ, zhùfú tā píngpíng'ān'ān de zhǎngdà.
examples.english: My friend's child has reached one month old. I want to give him a present, wishing him to grow up safely and soundly.

examples.chinese: 除夕那天我送給父母一萬塊的紅包，祝福他們新年快樂，大吉大利！
examples.pinyin: Chúxī nà tiān wǒ sòng gěi fùmǔ yí wàn kuài de hóngbāo, zhùfú tāmen xīnnián kuàilè, dàjí dàlì!
examples.english: On New Year's Eve, I gave my parents a red envelope with ten thousand dollars, wishing them a happy New Year and great good fortune!

examples.chinese: 在臺灣，孩子出生滿一個月的時候，有的父母會請客，慶祝孩子滿月。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, háizi chūshēng mǎn yí ge yuè de shíhou, yǒude fùmǔ huì qǐngkè, qìngzhù háizi mǎnyuè.
examples.english: In Taiwan, when a child is one month old, some parents will treat guests to celebrate the baby's full month.

examples.chinese: 張太太上個月生了一個女兒，我寫了一張卡片祝福她，希望孩子快快樂樂地長大。 我的孩子滿月時，收到很多朋友送的禮物和滿滿的祝福。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng tàitai shàng ge yuè shēng le yí ge nǚ'ér, wǒ xiě le yì zhāng kǎpiàn zhùfú tā, xīwàng háizi kuàikuàilèlè de zhǎngdà. Wǒ de háizi mǎnyuè shí, shōudào hěn duō péngyou sòng de lǐwù hé mǎnmǎn de zhùfú.
examples.english: Mrs. Zhang gave birth to a daughter last month. I wrote a card to bless her, hoping the child will grow up happily. When my child was one month old, we received many gifts from friends and full blessings.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"鞭炮的聲音很可怕，把孩子嚇得哭起來了。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"等半夜十二點的鐘聲一響，我們就要放鞭炮慶祝新年了。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: 1. Biānpào de shēngyīn hěn kěpà, bǎ háizi xià de kū qǐlái le. 2. Děng bànyè shí'èr diǎn de zhōngshēng yì xiǎng, wǒmen jiù yào fàng biānpào qìngzhù xīnnián le.
examples.english: 1. The sound of firecrackers is very scary; it scared the child to tears. 2. When the midnight bell rings at twelve o'clock, we will set off firecrackers to celebrate the New Year.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"鞭炮的聲音很可怕，把孩子嚇得哭起來了。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"等半夜十二點的鐘聲一響，我們就要放鞭炮慶祝新年了。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: 1. Biānpào de shēngyīn hěn kěpà, bǎ háizi xià de kū qǐlái le. 2. Děng bànyè shí'èr diǎn de zhōngshēng yì xiǎng, wǒmen jiù yào fàng biānpào qìngzhù xīnnián le.
examples.english: 1. The sound of firecrackers is very scary; it scared the child to tears. 2. When the midnight bell rings at twelve o'clock, we will set off firecrackers to celebrate the New Year.

examples.chinese: 在春節的前一天，大多數的華人都會回到父母家一起慶祝。
examples.pinyin: Zài Chūnjié de qián yī tiān, dàduōshù de Huárén dōu huì huí dào fùmǔ jiā yīqǐ qìngzhù.
examples.english: On the day before the Spring Festival, most Chinese people return to their parents' home to celebrate together.

examples.chinese: 你打算用什麼方式慶祝父親六十歲的生日？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ dǎsuàn yòng shénme fāngshì qìngzhù fùqīn liùshí suì de shēngrì?
examples.english: What way do you plan to use to celebrate your father's 60th birthday?

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"今天是妹妹的生日，讓我們一起去 KTV 慶祝吧。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"弟弟還沒十八歲，爸爸不讓他喝酒。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān shì mèimei de shēngrì, ràng wǒmen yīqǐ qù KTV qìngzhù ba. / Dìdi hái méi shíbā suì, bàba bù ràng tā hē jiǔ.
examples.english: Today is younger sister's birthday; let's go to KTV to celebrate together. / Younger brother is not yet eighteen, so dad doesn't allow him to drink alcohol.

examples.chinese: 在台灣，不少人去KTV慶祝生日或是辦活動。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, bùshǎo rén qù KTV qìngzhù shēngrì huòshì bàn huódòng.
examples.english: In Taiwan, many people go to KTV to celebrate birthdays or hold events.

examples.chinese: 我們去 KTV 開心地慶祝朋友的生日。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen qù KTV kāixīn de qìngzhù péngyǒu de shēngrì.
examples.english: We went to KTV to happily celebrate a friend's birthday.

examples.chinese: 他們在KTV慶祝生日，又唱又跳，開心極了。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen zài KTV qìngzhù shēngrì, yòu chàng yòu tiào, kāixīn jí le.
examples.english: They are celebrating a birthday at KTV, singing and dancing, and are extremely happy.

examples.chinese: 你知道台灣人怎麼慶祝新年嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào Táiwān rén zěnme qìngzhù xīnnián ma?
examples.english: Do you know how Taiwanese people celebrate the New Year?

examples.chinese: 我們樂團今晚的表演很成功，一起放煙火來慶祝吧！
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yuètuán jīnwǎn de biǎoyǎn hěn chénggōng, yīqǐ fàng yānhuǒ lái qìngzhù ba!
examples.english: Our band's performance tonight was very successful; let's set off fireworks together to celebrate!

examples.chinese: 父母送我的結婚禮物很珍貴，包含了他們對我滿滿的祝福。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ sòng wǒ de jiéhūn lǐwù hěn zhēnguì, bāohán le tāmen duì wǒ mǎnmǎn de zhùfú.
examples.english: The wedding gift my parents gave me is very precious; it includes their full blessings for me.

examples.chinese: 想當年，出國留學的日子雖然很忙，卻很充實。算算日子，剩下兩個星期經理就要退休了。明天是我父母結婚三十年的重要日子，一定要好好地慶祝。
examples.pinyin: 1. Xiǎng dāngnián, chūguó liúxué de rìzi suīrán hěn máng, què hěn chōngshí. 2. Suàn suàn rìzi, shèngxià liǎng ge xīngqī jīnglǐ jiù yào tuìxiū le. 3. Míngtiān shì wǒ fùmǔ jiéhūn sānshí nián de zhòngyào rìzi, yídìng yào hǎohǎo de qìngzhù.
examples.english: 1. Thinking back to those days, although the days of studying abroad were busy, they were very fulfilling. 2. Counting the days, there are only two weeks left before the manager retires. 3. Tomorrow is the important day of my parents' thirtieth wedding anniversary; we must celebrate it well.

examples.chinese: 華人送禮最重心意，以這種方式向收禮的人表達關心與祝福。
examples.pinyin: Huárén sònglǐ zuì zhòng xīnyì, yǐ zhè zhǒng fāngshì xiàng shōu lǐ de rén biǎodá guānxīn yǔ zhùfú.
examples.english: Chinese people place the greatest value on thoughtfulness when giving gifts, using this way to express care and blessings to the recipient.

examples.chinese: 他上課時偷偷出去拿了蛋糕進來，原來是要幫老師慶祝生日。
examples.pinyin: Tā shàngkè shí tōutōu chūqù ná le dàngāo jìnlái, yuánlái shì yào bāng lǎoshī qìngzhù shēngrì.
examples.english: During class, he secretly went out and brought a cake in; it turned out he was going to help celebrate the teacher's birthday.

examples.chinese: 小王追求祝小姐好幾年了，不過祝小姐一直只把她當好友。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng zhuīqiú Zhù xiǎojiě hǎo jǐ nián le, búguò Zhù xiǎojiě yìzhí zhǐ bǎ tā dāng hǎoyǒu.
examples.english: Xiao Wang has been pursuing Miss Zhu for several years, but Miss Zhu has always only regarded him as a good friend.

examples.chinese: 他順利當上那家大飯店的廚師後，好多朋友都打電話祝賀他。
examples.pinyin: Tā shùnlì dāngshàng nà jiā dà fàndiàn de chúshī hòu, hǎoduō péngyǒu dōu dǎ diànhuà zhùhè tā.
examples.english: After he successfully became a chef at that big hotel, many friends called to congratulate him.

examples.chinese: 小周找到理想工作後，女友特地送了一條領帶當作禮物，還親手為他打領帶，祝賀他有個好的開始。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhōu zhǎodào lǐxiǎng gōngzuò hòu, nǚyǒu tèdì sòng le yī tiáo lǐngdài dāngzuò lǐwù, hái qīnshǒu wèi tā dǎ lǐngdài, zhùhè tā yǒu gè hǎo de kāishǐ.
examples.english: After Xiao Zhou found his ideal job, his girlfriend specially gave him a necktie as a gift, and even personally tied the necktie for him, congratulating him on a good start.

examples.chinese: 總統在廣場點燃煙火，跟民眾一起慶祝新年。
examples.pinyin: Zǒngtǒng zài guǎngchǎng diǎnrán yānhuǒ, gēn mínzhòng yìqǐ qìngzhù xīnnián.
examples.english: The president set off fireworks in the square and celebrated the New Year together with the public.

items.wordHook: a 礻(spirit) altar rests as an 兄(elder brother) smiles → here to 祝(wish well).

examples.chinese: 不少博物館裡的藝術品都是從古代保留到現代的，具有重要的時代意義。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo bówùguǎn lǐ de yìshùpǐn dōu shì cóng gǔdài bǎoliú dào xiàndài de, jùyǒu zhòngyào de shídài yìyì.
examples.english: Many artworks in museums have been preserved from ancient times to the present and have important historical significance.

items.wordHook: Combining 保(safeguard) and 留(keep): 保留 means keep, to preserve.

examples.chinese: 王教授有一本古書，那本書已經有幾百年的歷史了。
examples.pinyin: Wáng jiàoshòu yǒu yī běn gǔ shū, nà běn shū yǐjīng yǒu jǐ bǎi nián de lìshǐ le.
examples.english: Professor Wang has an old book; that book already has several hundred years of history.

examples.chinese: 這本小說介紹了許多中國的古人古事，內容既豐富又有趣。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn xiǎoshuō jièshào le xǔduō Zhōngguó de gǔrén gǔshì, nèiróng jì fēngfù yòu yǒuqù.
examples.english: This novel introduces many stories of ancient Chinese people and events; its content is both rich and interesting.

examples.chinese: 我的歷史作業寫完了，同時也把明天要報告的古蹟資料準備好了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de lìshǐ zuòyè xiě wán le, tóngshí yě bǎ míngtiān yào bàogào de gǔjì zīliào zhǔnbèi hǎo le.
examples.english: I finished my history homework, and at the same time I also prepared the information on historical sites for tomorrow's report.

examples.chinese: 古小姐做事的態度很積極，為了完成任務，總是很早就做好計畫，而且立刻實行。
examples.pinyin: Gǔ xiǎojiě zuòshì de tàidù hěn jījí, wèile wánchéng rènwù, zǒngshì hěn zǎo jiù zuò hǎo jìhuà, érqiě lìkè shíxíng.
examples.english: Miss Gu has a very proactive attitude toward work. In order to complete tasks, she always makes plans early and immediately carries them out.

examples.chinese: 這座古蹟已經有兩百多年的歷史。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò gǔjì yǐjīng yǒu liǎngbǎi duō nián de lìshǐ.
examples.english: This ancient relic already has a history of more than two hundred years.

examples.chinese: 這座古老的城市因為公共設備太舊，購物也不方便，不少人都搬走了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò gǔlǎo de chéngshì yīnwèi gōnggòng shèbèi tài jiù, gòuwù yě bù fāngbiàn, bùshǎo rén dōu bān zǒu le.
examples.english: Because this ancient city's public facilities are too old and shopping is also inconvenient, quite a few people have moved away.

examples.chinese: 不少博物館裡的藝術品都是從古代保留到現代的，具有重要的時代意義。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo bówùguǎn lǐ de yìshùpǐn dōu shì cóng gǔdài bǎoliú dào xiàndài de, jùyǒu zhòngyào de shídài yìyì.
examples.english: Many artworks in museums have been preserved from ancient times to the present and have important historical significance.

examples.chinese: 在真實世界中沒有「龍」這種動物，那只是古人的想像。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhēnshí shìjiè zhōng méiyǒu “lóng” zhè zhǒng dòngwù, nà zhǐshì gǔrén de xiǎngxiàng.
examples.english: In the real world, there is no such animal as a "dragon"; that is only the imagination of ancient people.

examples.chinese: 古先生很重視環保，購物時會準備環保袋，在餐廳吃飯也會用環保筷。
examples.pinyin: Gǔ xiānsheng hěn zhòngshì huánbǎo, gòuwù shí huì zhǔnbèi huánbǎo dài, zài cāntīng chīfàn yě huì yòng huánbǎo kuài.
examples.english: Mr. Gu attaches great importance to environmental protection; when shopping he prepares eco-friendly bags, and when eating in restaurants he also uses eco-friendly chopsticks.

examples.chinese: 時代進步了，女人在家庭和社會中的地位也跟著提高了。在古代中國，男人不應該進廚房的傳統觀念，也因為時代的改變而不同。
examples.pinyin: Shídài jìnbù le, nǚrén zài jiātíng hé shèhuì zhōng de dìwèi yě gēnzhe tígāo le. Zài gǔdài Zhōngguó, nánrén bù yīnggāi jìn chúfáng de chuántǒng guānniàn, yě yīnwèi shídài de gǎibiàn ér bùtóng.
examples.english: Times have progressed, and women's status in the family and society has risen accordingly. In ancient China, the traditional concept that men should not enter the kitchen has also changed with the times.

examples.chinese: 在古代的中國，只有有錢、有背景的人才可以去學校讀書。
examples.pinyin: Zài gǔdài de Zhōngguó, zhǐyǒu yǒu qián, yǒu bèijǐng de rén cái kěyǐ qù xuéxiào dúshū.
examples.english: In ancient China, only people with money and background could go to school to study.

examples.chinese: 在古代，大多數的人思想很保守。
examples.pinyin: Zài gǔdài, dàduōshù de rén sīxiǎng hěn bǎoshǒu.
examples.english: In ancient times, most people's thinking was very conservative.

examples.chinese: 在古代，大多數的人思想很保守。
examples.pinyin: Zài gǔdài, dàduōshù de rén sīxiǎng hěn bǎoshǒu.
examples.english: In ancient times, most people's thinking was very conservative.

examples.chinese: 在古代，大多數的人思想很保守。
examples.pinyin: Zài gǔdài, dàduōshù de rén sīxiǎng hěn bǎoshǒu.
examples.english: In ancient times, most people's thinking was very conservative.

examples.chinese: 這首古老民謠的風格很獨特，不管大人小孩都會唱。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shǒu gǔlǎo mínyáo de fēnggé hěn dútè, bùguǎn dàrén xiǎohái dōu huì chàng.
examples.english: The style of this ancient ballad is very unique; regardless of adults or children, everyone can sing it.

examples.chinese: 這個旅行團的目的地是中國北京(Beijing)，旅客目的是參觀古蹟及拜訪朋友。
examples.pinyin: Zhège lǚxíngtuán de mùdìdì shì Zhōngguó Běijīng, lǚkè mùdì shì cānguān gǔjì jí bàifǎng péngyǒu.
examples.english: The destination of this tour group is Beijing, China; the travelers' purpose is to visit historical sites and visit friends.

examples.chinese: 在古代，國王所說的話是絕對的，也是最高的命令。
examples.pinyin: Zài gǔdài, guówáng suǒ shuō de huà shì juéduì de, yě shì zuì gāo de mìnglìng.
examples.english: In ancient times, what the king said was absolute and also the highest command.

examples.chinese: 中國的古書雖然難懂，慢慢讀的話，我倒是多少能理解一些。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó de gǔshū suīrán nándǒng, mànman dú de huà, wǒ dàoshì duōshǎo néng lǐjiě yìxiē.
examples.english: Although ancient Chinese books are difficult to understand, if I read them slowly, I can more or less understand some of it.

examples.chinese: 那家博物館平日展覽的物品很多，中多半與古代科技有關。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā bówùguǎn píngrì zhǎnlǎn de wùpǐn hěn duō, qízhōng duōbàn yǔ gǔdài kējì yǒu guān.
examples.english: That museum exhibits many items on weekdays, most of which are related to ancient technology.

examples.chinese: 世界各地的神話雖然不見得都真實，卻能讓人們多少了解一些古代的風俗習慣。
examples.pinyin: Shìjiè gèdì de shénhuà suīrán bú jiàndé dōu zhēnshí, què néng ràng rénmen duōshǎo liǎojiě yīxiē gǔdài de fēngsú xíguàn.
examples.english: Although myths from around the world are not necessarily all true, they can still let people understand some ancient customs and habits to some extent.

examples.chinese: 中國古代的人們相信，當好人碰到危險或困難時，會有神仙到人間來幫助他們。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó gǔdài de rénmen xiāngxìn, dāng hǎorén pèng dào wēixiǎn huò kùnnán shí, huì yǒu shénxiān dào rénjiān lái bāngzhù tāmen.
examples.english: People in ancient China believed that when good people encountered danger or difficulties, immortals would come to the human world to help them.

examples.chinese: 古代人非常尊敬大自然，認為土地、山與河都有神。
examples.pinyin: Gǔdài rén fēicháng zūnjìng dàzìrán, rènwéi tǔdì, shān yǔ hé dōu yǒu shén.
examples.english: Ancient people greatly respected nature and believed that the land, mountains, and rivers all have deities.

examples.chinese: 要保持古文物原來的樣子不容易，需要好好照顧。
examples.pinyin: Yào bǎochí gǔ wénwù yuánlái de yàngzi bù róngyì, xūyào hǎohǎo zhàogù.
examples.english: It is not easy to keep ancient cultural artifacts in their original condition; they need to be well taken care of.

examples.chinese: 國立博物館正在展覽公元三百年左右的古文物。
examples.pinyin: Guólì bówùguǎn zhèngzài zhǎnlǎn gōngyuán sānbǎi nián zuǒyòu de gǔ wénwù.
examples.english: The National Museum is currently exhibiting ancient artifacts from around 300 AD.

examples.chinese: 他透過古典文學來討論古代與現代的文化差異。
examples.pinyin: Tā tòuguò gǔdiǎn wénxué lái tǎolùn gǔdài yǔ xiàndài de wénhuà chāyì.
examples.english: He discusses the cultural differences between ancient and modern times through classical literature.

examples.chinese: 我跟幾個愛好歷史的朋友一起組了社團，專門研究古文物。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn jǐ ge àihào lìshǐ de péngyǒu yìqǐ zǔ le shètuán, zhuānmén yánjiū gǔ wénwù.
examples.english: I formed a club together with several friends who love history, specifically to study ancient artifacts.

items.wordHook: A 十(ten) sits above a 口(mouth) like a deep wrinkle on an old face → 古(old).

examples.chinese: 有一些中式餐廳的桌上會擺一壺茶，要式客人覺得菜太油，就能喝口茶，解解嘴裡油膩的味道。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yīxiē zhōngshì cāntīng de zhuō shàng huì bǎi yī hú chá, yào shì kèrén juéde cài tài yóu, jiù néng hē kǒu chá, jiě jiě zuǐ lǐ yóunì de wèidào.
examples.english: Some Chinese restaurants place a pot of tea on the table; if guests feel the food is too oily, they can take a sip of tea to reduce the greasy taste in their mouths.

examples.chinese: 這裡的資源不多，大部分的石油得從國外進口。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de zīyuán bù duō, dà bùfèn de shíyóu děi cóng guówài jìnkǒu.
examples.english: There are not many resources here; most of the oil has to be imported from abroad.

examples.chinese: 想要讓身體健康，得先注意飲食，少吃太油、太鹹的食物；其次要培養每天運動的好習慣。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng yào ràng shēntǐ jiànkāng, děi xiān zhùyì yǐnshí, shǎo chī tài yóu, tài xián de shíwù; qícì yào péiyǎng měitiān yùndòng de hǎo xíguàn.
examples.english: If you want to be healthy, you must first pay attention to your diet and eat less greasy and salty food; secondly, you need to cultivate the good habit of exercising every day.

examples.chinese: 這兩個國家因為搶石油資源，而把對方當成了敵人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge guójiā yīnwèi qiǎng shíyóu zīyuán, ér bǎ duìfāng dāngchéng le dírén.
examples.english: These two countries, because they are fighting over oil resources, have regarded each other as enemies.

examples.chinese: 這道菜能夠這麼好吃，是因為加了特別的醬料，還有自己做的醬油。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài nénggòu zhème hǎochī, shì yīnwèi jiāle tèbié de jiàngliào, hái yǒu zìjǐ zuò de jiàngyóu.
examples.english: This dish can be so delicious because it has special sauce added, plus homemade soy sauce.

examples.chinese: A:醫生說我應該多運動，少吃太鹹、太油的東西，這樣才不容易生病。 B:就是說嘛！我跟你說過好多次了，你怎麼不聽呢？
examples.pinyin: A: Yīshēng shuō wǒ yīnggāi duō yùndòng, shǎo chī tài xián, tài yóu de dōngxi, zhèyàng cái bù róngyì shēngbìng. B: Jiùshì shuō ma! Wǒ gēn nǐ shuō guò hǎo duō cì le, nǐ zěnme bù tīng ne?
examples.english: A: The doctor said I should exercise more and eat less of things that are too salty or too oily; this way it's not easy to get sick. B: Exactly! I've told you many times, why don't you listen?

examples.chinese: 他明天要參加籃球比賽，我們去幫他加油吧！
examples.pinyin: Tā míngtiān yào cānjiā lánqiú bǐsài, wǒmen qù bāng tā jiāyóu ba!
examples.english: He is going to participate in a basketball game tomorrow; let's go cheer him on!

examples.chinese: 汽車的汽油燃燒不完全的話，容易產生很多廢氣。
examples.pinyin: Qìchē de qìyóu ránshāo bù wánquán de huà, róngyì chǎnshēng hěn duō fèiqì.
examples.english: If a car's gasoline does not burn completely, it easily produces a lot of exhaust fumes.

examples.chinese: 醫生提醒我少吃油、鹽和糖，以減輕身體的負擔。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng tíxǐng wǒ shǎo chī yóu, yán hé táng, yǐ jiǎnqīng shēntǐ de fùdān.
examples.english: The doctor reminded me to eat less oil, salt, and sugar in order to lighten the body's burden.

examples.chinese: 他們班明天有一場籃球比賽，我想到現場替他們加油。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen bān míngtiān yǒu yī chǎng lánqiú bǐsài, wǒ xiǎng dào xiànchǎng tì tāmen jiāyóu.
examples.english: Their class has a basketball game tomorrow; I want to go to the scene to cheer them on.

examples.chinese: 我曾經在賣精油的商店服務過一段時間。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ céngjīng zài mài jīngyóu de shāngdiàn fúwù guò yí duàn shíjiān.
examples.english: I once worked at a store that sells essential oils for a period of time.

examples.chinese: 想有效解決身材肥胖的問題，就應避免吃太肥的肉、太油的菜，同時還得多運動。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng yǒuxiào jiějué shēncái féipàng de wèntí, jiù yīng bìmiǎn chī tài féi de ròu, tài yóu de cài, tóngshí hái děi duō yùndòng.
examples.english: If you want to effectively solve the problem of being obese, you should avoid eating meat that is too fatty and dishes that are too oily, and at the same time you also need to exercise more.

examples.chinese: 弟弟不喜歡吃肉包子裡的餡，他覺得很油膩。
examples.pinyin: Dìdi bù xǐhuān chī ròubāozi lǐ de xiànr, tā juéde hěn yóunì.
examples.english: My younger brother doesn't like to eat the filling in meat buns; he thinks it's very greasy.

examples.chinese: 奶油不但種類多，並且是做甜點時不能少的材料。
examples.pinyin: Nǎiyóu bùdàn zhǒnglèi duō, bìngqiě shì zuò tiándiǎn shí bùnéng shǎo de cáiliào.
examples.english: Butter not only comes in many types, but is also an indispensable ingredient when making desserts.

examples.chinese: 在吃湯麵之前淋上點兒芝麻油，吃起來味道更好。
examples.pinyin: Zài chī tāngmiàn zhīqián lín shàng diǎnr zhīmayóu, chī qǐlái wèidào gèng hǎo.
examples.english: Before eating noodle soup, drizzle on a little sesame oil; it tastes even better.

examples.chinese: 自從政府宣布石油、電費雙漲的作法以來，反對的民眾人數已近七成。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng zhèngfǔ xuānbù shíyóu, diànfèi shuāng zhǎng de zuòfǎ yǐlái, fǎnduì de mínzhòng rénshù yǐ jìn qī chéng.
examples.english: Since the government announced the policy of raising both oil and electricity prices, the number of people opposed has approached seventy percent.

examples.chinese: 看到自己國家的國旗進入奧運會場，民眾也不斷揮著手上的小旗子，替自己的國家加油。
examples.pinyin: Kàn dào zìjǐ guójiā de guóqí jìnrù Àoyùn huìchǎng, mínzhòng yě búduàn huī zhe shǒu shàng de xiǎo qízi, tì zìjǐ de guójiā jiāyóu.
examples.english: Seeing their country's national flag enter the Olympic venue, the public also continuously waved the small flags in their hands to cheer for their country.

items.wordHook: Liquid 氵(water) essence pressed directly 由(from) seeds yields cooking 油(oil).
A 且(qiě) shelf holds up a heavy load, lending its 力(strength) so the load won't fall → 助(help).
Combining 去(go) and 世(world): 去世 means die.
Combining 專(concentrated) and 櫃(cabinet): 專櫃 means brand counters.
游(swim) + 泳(swim) → 'swim-swim': 游泳 means to swim.
A 戶(single door) rests on the ⺼(meat) of your 肩(shoulders).
A 貝(money) dealer flips goods with 反(reverse) turns — buy low, reverse, sell high — a 販(merchant).
